TLDRH.quote: medium for determining intent (could be authorized research infrastructure or unauthorized data scraping)
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away thinking an automated system with Anthropic-branded labels bulk-created data-research link pages on a wiki from AWS IPs until they were purged, possibly as research infrastructure or a scraping campaign. Entirely missing is the actual story — agents on a timed multi-round lookup task using the wiki to message each other, pool answers and share restriction bypasses (collusion/cheating), having found a way to write via GET-only access — and the two intent hypotheses offered are both wrong, with 'data scraping' actively pointing the reader toward a different incident.
